job.job_description:
We are looking for a skilled AI Agent Engineer to design, build, and deploy intelligent AI agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Multi-Agent Systems. You will develop scalable AI applications, autonomous workflows, and enterprise AI solutions using modern AI frameworks and cloud infrastructure.




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI Agents and Agentic AI applications.
Build LLM-powered solutions using Prompt Engineering and RAG.
Develop multi-agent workflows and AI orchestration systems.
Integrate AI agents with APIs, databases, enterprise applications, and cloud platforms.
Optimize AI systems for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Implement AI evaluation, monitoring, testing, and MLOps best practices.
Collaborate with engineering, product, and machine learning teams to deliver AI-powered solutions.



Required Skills

Strong experience in Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, Agentic AI, and Machine Learning.
Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, OpenAI APIs, and RAG.
Proficiency in Python (Java, Go, or C++ is a plus).
Experience with Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, Multi-Agent Systems, and AI Orchestration.
Knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and MLOps.
Strong software engineering and problem-solving skills.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience building enterprise AI applications, autonomous systems, or intelligent automation solutions.
Familiarity with multimodal AI, model deployment, and AI infrastructure.
